text:
Mattias Ekholm is 36 and still one of the best play-driving defensemen in the league by the deeper numbers. Evolving-Hockey had his team creating more with him on the ice last season than with 98% of defensemen, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking puts him in the 98th percentile for getting to the home-plate area in front of the net. He scored against Vancouver on Saturday.

This season the scoreboard has been especially kind. The Oilers have scored about 14 more goals than their chances usually produce with him on the ice, the biggest luck number we have on anyone in this batch, and his shooting percentage (16.7%) is far above where a defenseman settles. He has eight points in 16 games and a good share of them came from that.

Strip out the luck and he's still valuable: Edmonton takes 52% of the expected goals with him on, about five points better than without. Our range has him at 31 to 50 points over a full season. His minutes have dipped a little lately, and Oilers Nation has been asking whether he and Evan Bouchard need to play together. That's the thing to watch.
headline: Ekholm, older and still driving play
